# A spatial multi-omic portrait of survival outcome for clear cell renal cell carcinoma, Meyer et al., 2026

# Figure 4 and Figure S6/S7/S8

Data analysis scripts for re-creating Figure 4 and Figure S6/S7/S8. 

# Software requirements

```{r, message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(conflicted)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(foreach)
library(scran)
library(ggnewscale)
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::count)
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::filter)
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::select)
conflicts_prefer(base::setdiff)
# TO DO
```

# Read data

```{r}
# Available from Zenodo - DOI: TO DO
# File paths have to be adjusted by the user

## Genomics objects
mutation_anno <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/00_final_files/discovery_genomics_mutations_processed.csv") #formerly mut_anno
CNV_anno <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/00_final_files/discovery_genomics_CNVarms_processed.csv")
# formerly CNV_arm_sum_out

## Other
metadata_selected <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/00_final_files/discovery_metadata.csv")
metadata_selected <- metadata_selected %>% filter(!is.na(survival_ecotype))
metadata_mutation <- as.data.frame(metadata_selected[metadata_selected$PID %in% mutation_anno$PID,])
metadata_CNV <- as.data.frame(metadata_selected[metadata_selected$PID %in% unique(CNV_anno$PID),])
GOI <- read_tsv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/00_final_files/discovery_genomics_IntOGen_drivers.tsv") %>% pull(Symbol)
```

# Figure 4

## 4A

```{r, warning=FALSE}
# ONCOPRINT
snv <- mutation_anno
snv <- snv %>% filter(PID %in% metadata_selected$PID)
snv$mut_level <- snv$variant_consequence_combined
snv <- snv %>% select(PID, Genes, mut_level)
mut_levels_for_matrix <- snv %>% pull(mut_level) %>% unique()

# Select genes 
Genes_list <- snv %>% filter(Genes %in% GOI) %>% pull(Genes) %>% unique()
Genes_list <- Genes_list[!Genes_list %in% c("SF3B1", "STAG2", "ARHGAP35")]

# Main function
mut_list <- list()
placeholder_Genes <- Genes_list[1]
pids <- unique(snv$PID)
placeholder_pid <- pids[1]
for(mut in mut_levels_for_matrix){
    x <- snv %>%
    dplyr::filter(mut_level==mut,
                  Genes %in% Genes_list | 
                    grepl(paste0(paste0("^", Genes_list, "[,;]"), collapse="|"), Genes) |      
                    grepl(paste0(paste0("[,;]", Genes_list, "$"), collapse="|"), Genes) ) %>%  
    dplyr::select(PID, Genes) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(value=1) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()
  if(dim(x)[1]!=0){
    x <- x %>%
      tidyr::spread(Genes, value)
    y <- x %>% column_to_rownames("PID")
    y <- t(y)
    y[is.na(y)] <- 0
    
  }else{
    y <- tibble(0)
    colnames(y) <- placeholder_pid
    rownames(y) <- placeholder_Genes
  }
  
  mut_list[[mut]] <- as.matrix(y)
}
mut_list_full <- unify_mat_list(mut_list)
sum_matrix <- Reduce(`+`, mut_list_full)
mut_list_full$multiple <- as.matrix(ifelse(sum_matrix > 1, 1,0))
for (i in seq_along(mut_list_full)){
  dif_gen = setdiff(Genes_list,rownames(mut_list_full[[i]]))
  dif_pat = setdiff(pids,colnames(mut_list_full[[i]]))
  blank= matrix(ncol=length(dif_pat),nrow=length(rownames(mut_list_full[[i]])),0)
  colnames(blank)=dif_pat
  rownames(blank)=rownames(mut_list_full[[i]])
  mut_list_full[[i]]=cbind(mut_list_full[[i]],blank)
  blank= matrix(ncol=ncol(mut_list_full[[i]]),nrow=length(dif_gen),0)
  colnames(blank)=colnames(mut_list_full[[i]])
  rownames(blank)=dif_gen
  mut_list_full[[i]]=rbind(mut_list_full[[i]],blank)
}

# Clonality anno
subclonal_anno <- mutation_anno %>% select(PID, Genes, clonality) %>% unique() %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = PID, names_from = Genes, values_from = clonality) %>% column_to_rownames("PID")
subclonal_anno[is.na(subclonal_anno)] <- "none"
subclonal_anno <- t(ifelse(subclonal_anno == "subclonal", 1, 0))
subclonal_anno <- subclonal_anno[match(rownames(mut_list_full$missense_variant), rownames(subclonal_anno)),]
subclonal_anno <- subclonal_anno[,match(colnames(mut_list_full$missense_variant), colnames(subclonal_anno))]
mut_list_full$subclonal <- subclonal_anno

### PLOT 
## Step 1: Define alteration function
col <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(8,"Paired"))(length(unique(snv$mut_level)))
names(col) <- c("missense_variant", "DELETION", "frameshift_variant", 
"inframe_del_ins", "splice_site", "AMPLIFICATION", "protein_altering_variant", "stop_gained_lost_start_lost")
fun_alter = list(
  background = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w, h, gp = gpar(fill = "#e7e7e7", col = "white")),
  missense_variant = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.8, h*0.4, gp = gpar(fill = col[1], col = NA)),
  DELETION = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.8, h*0.8, gp = gpar(fill = col[2], col = NA)),
  frameshift_variant = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.8, h*0.4, gp = gpar(fill = col[3], col = NA)),
  inframe_del_ins = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.4, h*0.8, gp = gpar(fill = col[4], col = NA)),
  splice_site = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.4, h*0.8, gp = gpar(fill = col[5], col = NA)),
  AMPLIFICATION = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.8, h*0.8, gp = gpar(fill = col[6], col = NA)),
  protein_altering_variant = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.4, h*0.8, gp = gpar(fill = col[7], col = NA)),
  stop_gained_lost_start_lost = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w*0.8, h*0.4, gp = gpar(fill = col[8], col = NA)),
  multiple = function(x, y, w, h) grid.points(x, y, size = unit(0.4, "char"), pch = 8),
  subclonal = function(x, y, w, h) grid.points(x, y, size = unit(0.4, "char"), pch = 16)
)

## Step 2: Column Annotation
c_anno <- data.frame(PID = colnames(mut_list_full[1]$missense_variant))
c_anno$cohort <- mutation_anno$cohort[match(c_anno$PID, mutation_anno$PID)]
c_anno$survival_ecotypes <- metadata_selected$survival_ecotypes[match(c_anno$PID, metadata_selected$PID)]
cohort_col <- setNames(brewer.pal(3, "Paired")[1:2],unique(c_anno$cohort))
col_group <- setNames(c("#0571B0", "gold3", "#CA0020"),c("Favorable","Medium","Poor"))

ca <- columnAnnotation(
  archetypes = c_anno$survival_ecotypes,
  seq_cohort = c_anno$cohort,
                   col = list(seq_cohort = cohort_col,
                              archetypes = col_group),
                   border = TRUE
                   )

## Step 3: Row Annotation 
r_anno <- data.frame(genes = rownames(mut_list_full[1]$missense_variant))
r_anno$key_genes <- ifelse(r_anno$genes %in% c("VHL","PBRM1","BAP1","SETD2"), "key_driver", "other_driver")

## Step 4: Print Oncoprint
ht_all <- oncoPrint(mut_list_full,
                  alter_fun = fun_alter,
                  row_split = r_anno$key_genes,
                  col = col, 
                  show_row_names = TRUE, show_column_names = TRUE, 
                  pct_side = "right", row_names_side = "left")%v% ca
  

draw(ht_all)
```

## 4B

```{r}
# Mutation encoding 
## Only clonal 
sum_matrix <- Reduce(`+`, mut_list_full)
sum_matrix <- as.matrix(ifelse(sum_matrix >= 1, 1,0))
sum_matrix[mut_list_full$subclonal == 1] <- 0.5
mut_per_PID <- as.data.frame(t(sum_matrix)) %>% rownames_to_column("PID")
mut_per_PID <- as.data.frame(mut_per_PID)
mut_per_PID_clonal <- mut_per_PID
mut_per_PID_clonal[2:ncol(mut_per_PID_clonal)] <- ifelse(mut_per_PID_clonal[2:ncol(mut_per_PID_clonal)] >= 1, 1,0)
colnames(mut_per_PID_clonal)[2:ncol(mut_per_PID_clonal)] <- paste0(colnames(mut_per_PID_clonal)[2:ncol(mut_per_PID_clonal)], "_clonal")
GOI_clonal <- colnames(mut_per_PID_clonal %>% select(-PID))
for (entry in GOI_clonal) {
  metadata_mutation[,entry] <- mut_per_PID_clonal[,entry][match(metadata_mutation[,"PID"],mut_per_PID_clonal[,"PID"])]
}
GOI_clonal <- GOI_clonal[!GOI_clonal %in% c("SF3B1_clonal","STAG2_clonal","ARHGAP35_clonal")]

# Patient group infos 
cur_groups <- metadata_mutation %>% select(PID, Favorable, Medium, Poor) %>% unique()
cur_mut_clonal <- metadata_mutation %>% as.data.frame %>% select(PID, GOI_clonal) %>% unique() %>% remove_rownames %>% column_to_rownames("PID") %>% t()

# Function to perform Fisher exact test 
perform_fisher_test <- function(gene_row, group1_cols, group2_cols) {
    contingency_table <- matrix(0, nrow = 2, ncol = 2)
    contingency_table[1, 1] <- sum(gene_row[group1_cols] == 1)
    contingency_table[1, 2] <- sum(gene_row[group2_cols] == 1)
    contingency_table[2, 1] <- sum(gene_row[group1_cols] == 0)
    contingency_table[2, 2] <- sum(gene_row[group2_cols] == 0)
    test_result <- fisher.test(contingency_table)
    return(c(odds_ratio = test_result$estimate, p_value = test_result$p.value))
  }
  
fisher_full <- foreach(i = c("Favorable", "Medium","Poor"), .combine = "rbind")%do%{
  PID_high <- unique(cur_groups[cur_groups[, i] == "1",]$PID)
  PID_low <- unique(cur_groups[cur_groups[, i] == "0",]$PID)
  PID_high <- PID_high[!is.na(PID_high)]
  PID_low <- PID_low[!is.na(PID_low)]
  fisher_results <- apply(cur_mut_clonal, 1, perform_fisher_test, group1_cols = PID_high, group2_cols = PID_low)
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(fisher_results)
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(t(fisher_results)) %>% rownames_to_column("gene")
  fisher_results$p_adj <- p.adjust(fisher_results$p_value, method = "BH")
  fisher_results$category <- i
  return(fisher_results)
  }
isGreater <- fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1
pVal <- log10(fisher_full$p_value)
pVal[isGreater] <- abs(pVal[isGreater])
fisher_full$p_out <- pVal
colnames(fisher_full) <- c("gene", "odds_ratio", "p_value", "p_adj", "category", "p_out")

# FDR at 0.1 with trends
fisher_full$result <- ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1 & fisher_full$p_adj < 0.1, "UP",
                             ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1 & fisher_full$p_value < 0.05, "UP_trend", 
                                    ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio < 1 & fisher_full$p_adj < 0.1, "DOWN", 
                                           ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio < 1 & fisher_full$p_value < 0.05, "DOWN_trend","NOTSIG"))))

fisher_full$odds_ratio[fisher_full$odds_ratio == Inf] <- max(fisher_full$odds_ratio[!fisher_full$odds_ratio == Inf])

# Arrange rows/columns
cur_df <- fisher_full %>% select(gene, category, odds_ratio) %>% pivot_wider(values_from = odds_ratio, names_from = gene)
dd <- dist(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)], method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
row_sorted <- hc$order
fisher_full$category <- factor(fisher_full$category, levels = cur_df[row_sorted,]$category)
fisher_full$category <- factor(fisher_full$category, levels = c("Poor", "Medium", "Favorable"))
dd <- dist(t(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)]), method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
column_sorted <- hc$order
fisher_full$gene <- factor(fisher_full$gene, levels = colnames(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)][,column_sorted]))

# Filter
mut_selected <- fisher_full %>% filter(result != "NOTSIG") %>% pull(gene) %>% unfactor
fisher_full_selected <- fisher_full %>% filter(gene %in% mut_selected)

# Plot
ggplot(fisher_full_selected, aes(x=category, y = gene,col = odds_ratio, size = -log10(p_adj)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8", midpoint = 1)+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = fisher_full_selected,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(p_adj), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#9f1214","UP_trend" = "#e73032", "NOTSIG" = "snow2", "DOWN_trend" = "#428bc7","DOWN" = "#25567d"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  coord_flip()
```

## 4C

```{r}
# ONCOPRINT
cnv <- CNV_anno %>% filter(type_summarized %in% c("loss_neutral", "loss", "gain_neutral", "gain"))
cnv$type_final <- ifelse(cnv$type_summarized %in% c("loss_neutral", "loss"), "loss", "gain")
cnv <- cnv %>% filter(PID %in% metadata_selected$PID)
cnv$mut_level <- cnv$type_final
cnv <- cnv %>% select(PID, chr_arm, mut_level)
mut_levels_for_matrix <- cnv %>% pull(mut_level) %>% unique()

# Select chromosome arms 
chr_arm_list <- cnv %>% pull(chr_arm) %>% unique()

# Main function
mut_list <- list()
placeholder_chr_arm <- chr_arm_list[1]
pids <- unique(cnv$PID)
placeholder_pid <- pids[1]
for(mut in mut_levels_for_matrix){
  x <- cnv %>%
    dplyr::filter(mut_level==mut,
                  chr_arm %in% chr_arm_list | 
                    grepl(paste0(paste0("^", chr_arm_list, "[,;]"), collapse="|"), chr_arm) |       
                    grepl(paste0(paste0("[,;]", chr_arm_list, "$"), collapse="|"), chr_arm) ) %>%  
    dplyr::select(PID, chr_arm) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(value=1) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()
  if(dim(x)[1]!=0){
    x <- x %>%
      tidyr::spread(chr_arm, value)
    y <- x %>% column_to_rownames("PID")
    y <- t(y)
    y[is.na(y)] <- 0
    
  }else{
    y <- tibble(0)
    colnames(y) <- placeholder_pid
    rownames(y) <- placeholder_chr_arm
  }
  
  mut_list[[mut]] <- as.matrix(y)
}
mut_list_full <- unify_mat_list(mut_list)
for (i in seq_along(mut_list_full)){
  dif_gen = setdiff(chr_arm_list,rownames(mut_list_full[[i]]))
  dif_pat = setdiff(pids,colnames(mut_list_full[[i]]))
  blank= matrix(ncol=length(dif_pat),nrow=length(rownames(mut_list_full[[i]])),0)
  colnames(blank)=dif_pat
  rownames(blank)=rownames(mut_list_full[[i]])
  mut_list_full[[i]]=cbind(mut_list_full[[i]],blank)
  blank= matrix(ncol=ncol(mut_list_full[[i]]),nrow=length(dif_gen),0)
  colnames(blank)=colnames(mut_list_full[[i]])
  rownames(blank)=dif_gen
  mut_list_full[[i]]=rbind(mut_list_full[[i]],blank)
}

# Clonality anno
subclonal_anno <- CNV_anno %>% filter(type_summarized %in% c("loss_neutral", "loss", "gain_neutral", "gain")) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = PID, names_from = chr_arm, values_from = clonality) %>% column_to_rownames("PID")
subclonal_anno[is.na(subclonal_anno)] <- "none"
subclonal_anno <- t(ifelse(subclonal_anno == "subclonal", 1, 0))
subclonal_anno <- subclonal_anno[match(rownames(mut_list_full$loss), rownames(subclonal_anno)),]
subclonal_anno <- subclonal_anno[,match(colnames(mut_list_full$loss), colnames(subclonal_anno))]
mut_list_full$subclonal <- subclonal_anno

## Step 1: Define alteration function
col <- c("#E41A1C", "#377EB8")
fun_alter = list(
  background = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w, h, gp = gpar(fill = "#e7e7e7", col = "white")),
  gain = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w, h, gp = gpar(fill = "#E41A1C", col = NA)),
  loss = function(x, y, w, h) grid.rect(x, y, w, h, gp = gpar(fill = "#377EB8", col = NA)),
  subclonal = function(x, y, w, h) grid.points(x, y, size = unit(0.4, "char"), pch = 16)
)
names(col) <- c("gain", "loss") 

## Step 2: Column Annotation
c_anno <- data.frame(PID = colnames(mut_list_full[1]$loss))
c_anno$cohort <- "old"
c_anno$survival_ecotype <- metadata_selected$survival_ecotype[match(c_anno$PID, metadata_selected$PID)]
cohort_col <- setNames("#1F78B4","old")
col_group <- setNames(c("#0571B0", "gold3", "#CA0020"),c("Favorable","Medium","Poor"))
ca <- columnAnnotation(
  archetypes = c_anno$survival_ecotype,
  seq_cohort = c_anno$cohort,
  col = list(seq_cohort = cohort_col,
             archetypes = col_group),
  border = TRUE
  )

## Step 4: Print Oncoprint
ht_all <- oncoPrint(mut_list_full,
                  alter_fun = fun_alter,
                  col = col, 
                  show_row_names = TRUE, show_column_names = TRUE, 
                  pct_side = "right", row_names_side = "left")%v%ca
  
draw(ht_all)
```

## 4E 

```{r}
genomic_sub <- mutation_anno %>% select("PID", "VHL", "BAP1", "PBRM1", "SETD2", "PTEN", "genomic_subtype") %>% unique()
genomic_sub <- genomic_sub %>% filter(PID %in% metadata_selected$PID)
mut_mat <- genomic_sub %>% column_to_rownames("PID") %>% select(VHL, BAP1, PBRM1, SETD2, PTEN) 
driver_mat_anno <- genomic_sub
driver_mat_anno <- driver_mat_anno[match(rownames(mut_mat), driver_mat_anno$PID),]
driver_mat_anno$BF_PL_TME_archetypes <- metadata_selected$BF_PL_TME_archetypes[match(driver_mat_anno$PID, metadata_selected$PID)]
driver_mat_anno$status_OS <- metadata_selected$status_OS[match(driver_mat_anno$PID, metadata_selected$PID)]
driver_mat_anno$OS_months <- metadata_selected$OS_months[match(driver_mat_anno$PID, metadata_selected$PID)]

# Column Annotation
subtype_col <- setNames(c("#046C9A", "#000000", "#D69C4E", "#ECCBAE", "#ABDDDE"),sort(unique(driver_mat_anno$genomic_subtype)))
col_group <- setNames(c("#0571B0", "gold3", "#CA0020"),c("TME_activated","TME_silent","TME_suppressed"))
ca <- columnAnnotation(genomic_subtype = driver_mat_anno$genomic_subtype,
                       archetype = driver_mat_anno$BF_PL_TME_archetypes,
                       col = list(genomic_subtype = subtype_col,
                                  archetype = col_group))

# Create heatmap 
ht_mut_anno <- Heatmap(t(mut_mat), name = "Mutation status", 
                       col = colorRamp2(c(0, 0.5, 1), c("lightgrey","#A6CEE3","#1F78B4")), 
                       column_split = driver_mat_anno$genomic_subtype, 
                       column_title = "Genomic subtypes", 
                       cluster_column_slices = FALSE, show_column_names = FALSE)%v%ca

draw(ht_mut_anno)
```

## 4G

```{r}
metadata_mutation$genomic_subtype <- genomic_sub$genomic_subtype[match(metadata_mutation$PID, genomic_sub$PID)]
metadata_mutation$VHL_wildtype <- ifelse(metadata_mutation$genomic_subtype == "VHL_wildtype", "1", "0")
metadata_mutation$PBRM1_driven <- ifelse(metadata_mutation$genomic_subtype == "PBRM1_driven", "1", "0")
metadata_mutation$BAP1_driven <- ifelse(metadata_mutation$genomic_subtype == "BAP1_driven", "1", "0")
metadata_mutation$VHL_monodriver <- ifelse(metadata_mutation$genomic_subtype == "VHL_monodriver", "1", "0")
metadata_mutation$multiple_drivers <- ifelse(metadata_mutation$genomic_subtype == "multiple_drivers", "1", "0")

# Patient group infos
cur_groups <- metadata_mutation %>% select(PID, Favorable, Medium, Poor) %>% unique()
cur_mut_clonal <- metadata_mutation %>% as.data.frame %>% select(PID, VHL_wildtype, VHL_monodriver, BAP1_driven, PBRM1_driven, multiple_drivers) %>% unique() %>% remove_rownames %>% column_to_rownames("PID") %>% t()

fisher_full <- foreach(i = c("Favorable", "Medium","Poor"), .combine = "rbind")%do%{
  PID_high <- unique(cur_groups[cur_groups[, i] == "1",]$PID)
  PID_low <- unique(cur_groups[cur_groups[, i] == "0",]$PID)
  PID_high <- PID_high[!is.na(PID_high)]
  PID_low <- PID_low[!is.na(PID_low)]
  fisher_results <- apply(cur_mut_clonal, 1, perform_fisher_test, group1_cols = PID_high, group2_cols = PID_low)
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(fisher_results)
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(t(fisher_results)) %>% rownames_to_column("gene")
  fisher_results$p_adj <- p.adjust(fisher_results$p_value, method = "BH")
  fisher_results$category <- i
  return(fisher_results)
  }
isGreater <- fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1
pVal <- log10(fisher_full$p_value)
pVal[isGreater] <- abs(pVal[isGreater])
fisher_full$p_out <- pVal
colnames(fisher_full) <- c("gene", "odds_ratio", "p_value", "p_adj", "category", "p_out")

# FDR at 0.1 with trends
fisher_full$result <- ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1 & fisher_full$p_adj < 0.1, "UP",
                             ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1 & fisher_full$p_value < 0.05, "UP_trend", 
                                    ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio < 1 & fisher_full$p_adj < 0.1, "DOWN", 
                                           ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio < 1 & fisher_full$p_value < 0.05, "DOWN_trend","NOTSIG"))))
fisher_full$odds_ratio[fisher_full$odds_ratio == Inf] <- max(fisher_full$odds_ratio[!fisher_full$odds_ratio == Inf])

## Arrange rows/columns
cur_df <- fisher_full %>% select(gene, category, odds_ratio) %>% pivot_wider(values_from = odds_ratio, names_from = gene)
dd <- dist(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)], method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
row_sorted <- hc$order
fisher_full$category <- factor(fisher_full$category, levels = cur_df[row_sorted,]$category)
fisher_full$category <- factor(fisher_full$category, levels = c("Poor", "Medium", "Favorable"))
dd <- dist(t(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)]), method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
column_sorted <- hc$order
fisher_full$gene <- factor(fisher_full$gene, levels = colnames(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)][,column_sorted]))

# Plot
ggplot(fisher_full, aes(x=category, y = gene,col = odds_ratio, size = -log10(p_adj)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8", midpoint = 1)+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = fisher_full,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(p_adj), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#9f1214","UP_trend" = "#e73032", "NOTSIG" = "snow2", "DOWN_trend" = "#428bc7","DOWN" = "#25567d"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  coord_flip()
```
